P.name: Granite Shield
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Shard of the Monolith:}} '''Malphite''' gains increased percentage [[size]] equal to {{as|8% of his '''total''' armor}}, capped at 35% increased size at {{as|{{fd|{{#expr:35/0.08}}}} armor}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Granite Shield:}} '''Malphite''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{as|10% of his '''maximum''' health}}. The shield lasts until it is broken, and replenishes to full strength after a few seconds of not taking damage.

Q.name: Seismic Shard
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' sends a shard to the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 3 seconds upon impact.
Q.description2: '''Malphite''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} equal to the {{tt|raw|before movement speed soft caps}} amount of {{as|movement speed}} the target lost from the slow for the duration.

W.name: Thunderclap
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Malphite''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, tripled while ''{{ai|Granite Shield|Malphite}}'' is active.
W.leveling: {{st|Bonus Armor|{{as|{{ap|10 to 30}}% armor}}|Increased Bonus Armor|{{as|{{ap|10*3 to 30*3}}% armor}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' empowers his next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{ccs|{{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}|physical}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
W.description3: Additionally, '''Malphite's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} for the next 5 seconds are empowered to trigger a cone in the direction of the target that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.

E.name: Ground Slam
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' slams the ground beneath him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|cripple|crippling}} them for 3 seconds.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|(+ 40% armor)}}}}{{st|Cripple Strength|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}

R.name: Unstoppable Force
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' {{tip|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
